events.investigating: Initial conception of CausalFade for an advanced statistics course: whether aggressive PTQ increases AI agents' reliance on misleading observational associations.
events.understood_at_time: Literature review of 14 papers (2025-2026) showed 4-bit static causal QA is surprisingly robust (Nwaiwu et al., 2025), while 2-bit reasoning suffers token inflation/looping (Alimaskina et al., 2026) and parametric recall drops faster than context copying (PRISM, 2026).
events.available_evidence: 14 downloaded PDFs, SHA-256 manifest, critical summaries, and EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md.
events.decision_made: Frame primary target around behavioral conflict penalty Delta(p) = ConflictPenalty(p) - ConflictPenalty(F16) on synthetic SCMs, explicitly distinguishing true SCM graphs, reported graphs, and internal neural circuits.
events.documented_rationale: Avoid unsustainable claims that quantization 'severs internal causal graphs' from accuracy alone (literature review/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md).
events.subsequent_impact: Established strict epistemic discipline against overclaiming mechanisms that governed all 29 cohorts.
events.retrospective_assessment: Supported: early restraint prevented major scientific errors when behavioral anomalies emerged.

events.investigating: Constructing the binary confounded SCM simulator (Z->X, Z->Y, X->Y) and validating a CNI-style (C, A, B) multinomial processing tree.
events.understood_at_time: Crossing beneficial/harmful causal effects with positive/negative confounding yields 4 cells that can separate cue sensitivity from action preference.
events.available_evidence: 24-family synthetic export (192 prompts) and 3,600 Monte Carlo EM recovery fits across 6 parameter scenarios and 3 sample sizes.
events.decision_made: Commit simulator, scorer, paired bootstrap analyzer, and C/A/B fitter, while explicitly documenting near-boundary nonconvergence (16/3600) and symmetric logistic observational equivalence.
events.documented_rationale: Synthetic validation checks code correctness under assumed generators but cannot prove real LLMs follow the psychological tree (docs/METHODOLOGY_ADAPTATION.md).
events.subsequent_impact: Provided exact ground-truth SCM infrastructure for Cohorts 001-011 and pre-armed researchers to test the tree's additivity restriction.
events.retrospective_assessment: Supported: the pre-documented additivity check immediately invalidated homogeneous C/A/B fitting on real LLM data in Cohort 005.

events.investigating: Importing verified Qwen2.5-Instruct (0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B) baselines from AGERE and generating uniform GGUF quantizations (Q8_0, Q4_K_M, Q2_K, Q1_0).
events.understood_at_time: Controlled quantization studies require identical base checkpoints, a single quantizer binary (llama.cpp b12176), no uncalibrated mixed downloads, and strict code-in-Git vs weights-outside-Git separation.
events.available_evidence: docs/SSD_ASSET_REUSE.md, hash-verified import manifests, and quantization logs.
events.decision_made: Rebuild canonical 7B Q4_K_M with llama.cpp b12176 without an importance matrix; use Q1_0 instead of uncalibrated IQ1_S; document Study Roadmap v1.0.
events.documented_rationale: Prevent confounding nominal bit-width with differing quantizer versions or undocumented calibration corpora.
events.subsequent_impact: Guaranteed cryptographic weight provenance across subsequent Ubuntu lab runs.
events.retrospective_assessment: Supported as a reproducibility safeguard, though 0.5B, 1.5B, and Q1_0 were never queried once 3B/7B competence bottlenecks appeared.

events.investigating: Cohort 001 (3B F16 vs Q2_K vs exploratory Q4_K_M on 64 exact SCM prompts) and Cohort 003 (Q2_K CPU repacking diagnostic).
events.understood_at_time: First live LLM runs on the Ubuntu lab PC (CPU-only llama.cpp b12176 because RTX 4000 Ada was on nouveau without validated CUDA).
events.available_evidence: Cohort 001: 0/64 strict across all arms due to Markdown JSON fences; single-fence F16 33/64 (63/64 activate, 0/64 [Z]), Q4_K_M 34/64, Q2_K 0/64 (64/64 length-capped). Cohort 003: --no-repack 0/16 valid. Metadata audit: identical tokenizers/templates.
events.decision_made: Add labeled single-fence sensitivity; retire 3B Q2_K as an operational generation failure; normalize leaked home-directory usernames to $HOME/ in public run configs.
events.documented_rationale: Cannot measure selective causal degradation when Q2_K emits zero parseable objects and 3B F16 activates 63/64 times (DECISIONS.md 13:11-13:43 PKT).
events.subsequent_impact: Shifted focus from Q2_K to Q4_K_M/Q8_0 and initiated diagnostic controls for arithmetic, model scale, and source selection.
events.retrospective_assessment: Supported: Cohort 024 later confirmed Q2_K instability in Mistral while showing even 7B/8B F16 models struggled on direct tasks.

events.phase: Formula Controls, 7B Screen, and Source-Selection Pivot
events.investigating: Cohorts 002, 006, 007 (formula-given arithmetic controls on 3B F16, Q8_0, Q4_K_M), Cohort 004 (7B F16 direct screen), and Cohort 005 (3B supplied-rate source selection).
events.understood_at_time: In Cohort 002, F16 computed the right ATE sign on 61/64 formula items (and Q8_0 tied 61/64 in 006, while Q4 dropped to 45/64 in 002 and 31/48 vs 46/48 on fresh families in 007), YET F16 chose 'decline' on 64/64 explicit actions! Meanwhile 7B F16 failed Cohort 004 (17/32 despite 32/32 [Z]), and Cohort 005 violated C/A/B additivity (-43.75 pp) while showing a stark family-hashed order split.
events.available_evidence: Cohorts 002, 004, 005, 006, 007 raw responses and paired JSON analyses.
events.decision_made: Separate numeric estimate signs from explicit actions; withhold C/A/B latent parameter reporting; launch within-item source-order reversal (Cohort 008).
events.documented_rationale: Aggregate conflict penalties were distorted by default action biases, and family-assigned source order confounded Cohort 005's order pattern.
events.subsequent_impact: Pivoted the project from raw contingency tables to two-source (randomized vs historical) rate prompts and presentation-order crossovers.
events.retrospective_assessment: Crucial methodological turning point: discovered both numeric-vs-action dissociation and C/A/B misfit on the very first day of LLM runs.

events.phase: 3B Source-Order Crossovers, Matched Strength & Count-Bug Audit
events.investigating: Completing interrupted Cohort 008, running same-session interleaved order crossovers on reused (009) and fresh (010) families, matching observational signal strength (011), and auditing count aggregation.
events.understood_at_time: 3B F16 consistently lost 21.9 to 28.1 pp of conflict accuracy when historical evidence appeared first, while Q4_K_M sat at 50% (near-constant activate). Also discovered two bugs: original generator had larger aligned |delta_obs|, and analyze_interleaved_order.py halved displayed cell counts.
events.available_evidence: Cohorts 008-011 summaries, input_prevalidation/, and preserved *_v1_undercounted_counts.json files.
events.decision_made: Repair observational-strength imbalance in Cohort 011; fix count aggregator and withdraw false claim that Q4_K_M scored below always-activate while preserving v1 files; screen 7B F16 on matched-strength tasks (Cohort 012).
events.documented_rationale: Transparently correct code/design defects without rewriting history; verify competent higher-precision reference before confirmatory testing.
events.subsequent_impact: Established the matched-strength generator used in Cohorts 011-017, though inadvertently introducing a smaller-magnitude separation between randomized and historical gaps.
events.retrospective_assessment: Count-bug disclosure was exemplary reproducibility practice; however, matched historical strength m in [0.38, 0.46) > e in [0.06, 0.12) later proved vulnerable to a source-blind magnitude shortcut.

events.phase: 7B Contract Refinement & Cohort 016 Prospective Order Confirmation
events.investigating: 7B F16 reference screens (012-015), strict bare-JSON contract enforcement (014), conditional 7B Q4_K_M screen (015), and 96-family prospective confirmation (016).
events.understood_at_time: Cohort 012 failed conflict gates; Cohort 013 causal-context prose caused 64/64 160-token truncations; Cohort 014 strict 48-token JSON fixed validity (128/128) and Cohort 015 F16 cleared all gates (89/128), unlocking 7B Q4_K_M—which showed a massive +65.6 pp historical-first conflict jump! Cohort 016 prospectively confirmed this on 96 fresh families (+62.5 pp, t(95)=21.10, p=1.24e-37).
events.available_evidence: Cohorts 012-016 frozen plans, power_analysis.json, and primary_analysis.json.
events.decision_made: Confirm the 7B Q4_K_M conflict-order effect for this setup, refuse to call it selective causal degradation (since aligned items dropped from 192/192 to 105/192), and formally foreground causal inference as CausalFade's central pillar (058e3c7).
events.documented_rationale: Prompt-order sensitivity on scaffolded rates is not proof of causal inference or selective quantization damage (DECISIONS.md 2026-11-12).
events.subsequent_impact: Produced the project's strongest prospective statistical replication while motivating deep construct-validity diagnostics to understand WHY order mattered.
events.retrospective_assessment: Supported statistically (+62.5 pp is ironclad), and the refusal to overclaim saved the project when Cohort 017 failed to generalize it to 14B and manuscript audits uncovered the smaller-gap shortcut.

events.investigating: 14B cross-size follow-up (017), Interdisciplinary Follow-Up design, graded sensitivity/mapping (018), within-world K/M vs semantic contracts (019), isolated components (020), and governing-source selection + explicit guidance (021).
events.understood_at_time: 14B Q8/Q4 did not reproduce 7B's conflict-order effect (-4.17 pp and 0 pp). In 7B F16, reversed token mappings crushed accuracy (018-019), noncausal controls showed similar order shifts (018-019), and in Cohort 021 the model selected the randomized governing study 128/128 times (100%) and solved randomized-only stems 30/32 times, yet scored 58/128 on both ordinary AND explicitly guided two-source decisions!
events.available_evidence: Cohort 017 recovered analysis + Cohorts 018-021 strict-valid F16 archives and Publication Readiness Assessment (15 Nov 2026).
events.decision_made: Withhold Q4 across 018-021 due to failed F16 gates; stop tuning Qwen 7B prompts in isolation; test an independent model lineage next (Cohort 022).
events.documented_rationale: Correctly naming causal evidence in isolation does not translate into using it when historical rates are co-present; prompt tuning was hitting diminishing returns (docs/PUBLICATION_READINESS_2026-11-15.md).
events.subsequent_impact: Shifted research focus onto the dissociation between evidence recognition and decision execution, and triggered multi-lineage audits.
events.retrospective_assessment: Supported: Cohort 021's 128/128 vs 58/128 dissociation became one of CausalFade's sharpest diagnostic insights into LLM evaluation.

events.phase: Cross-Lineage Audits, 21-Arm Precision Matrix & Archive Screen (Cohorts 022-025)
events.investigating: Mistral replication (022), Qwen counterbalanced control audit (023), 3-lineage x 7-format 30,912-attempt matrix (024), and retrospective reanalysis of all 24 cohorts (025).
events.understood_at_time: Qwen's +55.5 to +56.6 pp two-source loss persisted across A/B names and option orders, but harmful-direction numeric (18/32) and noncausal scorecard (75/128) controls failed the 75% robustness gate. Mistral F16 selected the first displayed option on 256/256 source prompts (0/128 option-reversal invariance). Across 21 arms in Cohort 024, precision effects were non-monotone: Qwen/Mistral/Llama F16-to-Q4 semantic causal scores barely moved, whereas Llama Q4_K_M suffered 448 length-capped invalids concentrated in noncausal controls!
events.available_evidence: Cohorts 022-025 archives (40,032 completed raw attempts across 58 successful runs).
events.decision_made: Conclude that existing two-source rate prompts do not isolate selective quantization damage to causal reasoning; pivot to observationally identical graph-switch designs (Cohort 025.1 -> 026).
events.documented_rationale: Option-position policies, harmful-direction control failures, and format-specific truncation dominated apparent causal or compression contrasts (DECISIONS.md 18 Nov 2026).
events.subsequent_impact: Closed the supplied-rate quantization-sweep era and initiated exact-rational structural graph-switch experiments.
events.retrospective_assessment: Supported: Cohort 024 definitively refuted any simple monotone 'quantization selectively breaks causal reasoning' story on these tasks.

events.investigating: Cross-disciplinary audit (025.1), observationally identical confounder vs mediator graph switches (026), full answer-order counterbalancing across 4 F16 models (027), and offloading arithmetic to an allowlisted deterministic calculator (028).
events.understood_at_time: Cohort 026 exposed first an oracle Y-complement bug (v1 invalidated) and then an option-order coupling where Llama picked the 1st option 61/64 times. Cohort 027 fixed counterbalancing: all 4 F16 models (Qwen 3B/7B, Mistral 7B, Llama 8B) got 0/8 order-robust paired switch fidelity! Cohort 028 tested whether arithmetic was the culprit: deterministic calculator C rescued noncausal controls (Qwen 58->128/128, Llama 68->112/128) yet failed to rescue causal tasks (Qwen 65->68/128, Llama 71->60/128) because models could not select 'marginal' for confounders vs 'conditional' for mediators!
events.available_evidence: Cohort 026-028 run directories, Supervisor Progress Report (19 Nov 2026), and pipeline_status.json ('stopped_by_gate').
events.decision_made: Honor frozen stopping gates on Cohorts 026, 027, and 028 without launching validation or quantization sweeps; design one final self-contained, shortcut-audited prospective benchmark (CF-TP1, Cohort 029).
events.documented_rationale: Further quantization sweeps on unqualified references would measure noise; meanwhile, retrospective audit of Cohort 016 revealed a smaller-gap magnitude heuristic, motivating a design where printed tables admit both provenance assignments.
events.subsequent_impact: Directly shaped the mathematical architecture of Cohort 029 (CF-TP1) and the final manuscript's methodological focus.
events.retrospective_assessment: Supported: Cohort 028's negative causal-rescue result (+2.34 pp and -8.59 pp vs +54.7 pp and +34.4 pp on controls) was a decisive diagnostic achievement.

events.phase: Cohort 029 (CF-TP1) Execution, Offline Verification & Final Manuscript
events.investigating: Prospective 128-family, 4,096-prompt evaluation of feasible provenance swaps and target-population transport versus matched explicit-scorecard arithmetic on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct Q4_K_M, followed by release verification and IEEE TNNLS manuscript preparation.
events.understood_at_time: All 4,096 responses completed strict-valid on 25 Nov 2026. Transfer causal target-pair fidelity was 128/512 (25.00%) vs arithmetic 146/512 (28.52%), Delta = -3.515625 pp (95% t CI [-7.77, +0.74], bounded [-27.52, +20.49], inconclusive). Directional diagnostics revealed 995/1024 causal activation (only 3/256 target reversals) vs 46/256 required and 45/256 unwarranted arithmetic flips. Offline replay passed 50/50 checks.
events.available_evidence: Annotated tag cohort-029-v1.0.0 (76206c2), PUBLICATION_HANDOFF.md (b737153), and manuscript/ package.
events.decision_made: Publish immutable release tag, disclose human-review key/timing limits and the RESULTS.md narrative direction-table correction in supplement.tex, and position the final manuscript as a methodological evaluation instrument and single-deployment case study rather than a quantization-degradation claim.
events.documented_rationale: Preserve complete fidelity to what the frozen experiment actually identified without exaggerating inconclusive contrasts or retrospective shortcut audits.
events.subsequent_impact: Produced the final archival release and manuscript package.
events.retrospective_assessment: Exemplary scientific integrity: transformed an initially over-optimistic compression hypothesis into a rigorous, reproducible benchmark and diagnostic methodology.
